main_measure.name: mean 48-bar directional excess return over the coin's normal drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t of the mean >= +2 with top-minus-bottom half above 0; reject: t <= -2; at least 100 cases

decided_by: Fewer than 90% of the nonzero-forecast bars are Sunday 23:00 bars with weekend volume above the prior weekdays' mean and a forecast sign equal to the 48-bar weekend return's sign.
reading: The situation bar is the bar starting Sunday 23:00 UTC (closing Monday 00:00), the volume ratio is mean volume of bars t-47..t over bars t-167..t-48 by row position in the window.
